title: TSX Moves Slightly Ahead to Conclude Quiet Session By Baystreet.ca - Investing.com Canada
description: The TSX Composite Index gained 20.35 points to close Thursday at 22,244.02. Communications, healthcare, and energy stocks led the gains, while industrials and financials saw some declines.

title: Here's Why Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Tumbled Nearly 13% in the 1st Half of 2024 - The Motley Fool
description: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners (BIP) saw a 12.9% decline in the first half of 2024, underperforming its corporate twin Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation (BIPC) and the broader S&P 500. The decline was likely due to a potential sale of BIP units by its parent Brookfield Corporation and the impact of higher interest rates on the company's borrowing costs and asset valuations.

title: Billionaire Investor Bill Ackman Has 100% of His $10 Billion Portfolio in Just 9 Stocks, But There Were Seismic Changes During the Quarter
description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman's $10 billion portfolio is concentrated in just 9 stocks, with significant changes during the quarter. He reduced his positions in Hilton, Chipotle, and Alphabet, while adding new stakes in Brookfield and Nike.

title: Bill Ackman Just Sold a 'Magnificent Seven' Stock. Here's What He Might Buy With All the Cash.
description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman's Pershing Square hedge fund recently sold Alphabet and several other stocks, raising cash. The article speculates that Ackman may be looking to use the funds for a potential deal to take real estate developer Howard Hughes private.

title: Partners Value Investments Inc. Announces Q2 2024 Interim Results
description: Partners Value Investments Inc. reported a net income of $94.5 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024, compared to a net loss of $120.4 million in the prior year quarter. The increase was primarily due to remeasurement gains associated with the retractable shares.

title: Partners Value Investments L.P. Announces Q2 2024 Interim Results
description: Partners Value Investments L.P. reported a net income of $21.6 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2024, driven by higher dividend income, foreign currency, tax, and investment valuation gains. The Partnership's principal investments are in Brookfield Corporation and Brookfield Asset Management Ltd.

title: Partners Value Split Corp. Announces 2024 Semi-Annual Results
description: Partners Value Split Corp. reported a net asset value per unit of $128.34 as of June 30, 2024, with income available for distribution increasing to $42 million from $37 million in the prior year period. The increase was due to higher dividend income from Brookfield Corporation and Brookfield Asset Management Inc. However, net comprehensive income decreased compared to the prior period due to lower unrealized gains on the share prices of these companies.

title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Slashed His Stake in This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock in Q2. Should You Sell It, Too?
description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman reduced his stake in Alphabet (Google's parent company) in the second quarter of 2024. The article discusses possible reasons for this move and whether investors should also sell their Alphabet shares.

title: Brookfield Announces Reset Dividend Rate on Its Series 40 Preference Shares
description: Brookfield Corporation announced the fixed dividend rate on its Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 40 for the next five years. Holders of these shares have the option to convert them into Series 41 Shares, which will pay a floating rate dividend.

title: Why Billionaire Bill Ackman Bought $514 Million of These 2 Stocks
description: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square hedge fund added two new stocks to its portfolio in Q2 2024: Brookfield Corp. and Nike. Ackman likely invested in these stocks due to their attractive valuations and strong underlying business fundamentals.

title: Brookfield Corporation Announces Results of Conversion of its Series 40 Preferred Shares
description: Brookfield Corporation announced that there were not enough Series 40 Shares tendered for conversion into Series 41 Shares, so the conversion will not take place. Holders of Series 40 Shares will retain their shares.

title: Brookfield Announces Steps to Enhance Corporate Structure and Broaden Shareholder Ownership of Brookfield Asset Management
description: Brookfield Asset Management (BAM) and Brookfield Corporation (BN) announced plans to simplify BAM's corporate structure, which is expected to increase BAM's market capitalization and enable broader index inclusion.

title: Want to Make a Lot of Money? Meet the Top Stock With a Plan to Enrich Its Investors Over the Next 5 Years and Beyond.
description: Brookfield Corporation, a Canadian investment firm, has delivered strong returns over the past 30 years and believes it can continue to grow shareholder value through its simple plan of identifying and improving high-quality businesses with resilient earnings and strong cash flows.

title: Brookfield Property Partners Declares Quarterly Dividends on Listed Preferred Units
description: Brookfield Property Partners announced quarterly distributions on its preferred units, payable on December 31, 2024, to holders of record on December 2, 2024.

title: Brookfield Corporation Receives Exemptive Relief from the Ontario Securities Commission
description: Brookfield Corporation (BN) has received exemptive relief from the Ontario Securities Commission for the arrangement to enhance the corporate structure of Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (BAM). The arrangement was jointly announced by BN and BAM on October 31, 2024.

title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Recently Bought One of My Favorite Stocks. Here's Why I Think It Was a Brilliant Move.
description: Billionaire Bill Ackman has significantly increased his stake in Brookfield, a company that the author believes has strong growth potential and a capable leadership team. The author expects Ackman's investment in Brookfield to be a profitable move.

title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Just Poured $2.2 Billion Into These 2 Incredible Stocks
description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman has been building significant positions in Nike and Brookfield, believing they are undervalued. Nike has struggled with its business model transition, but Ackman sees potential for a turnaround. Brookfield, an investment firm with a strong track record, is expected to continue growing its free cash flow and could be undervalued.

title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Bought These 2 Dividend Stocks Hand Over Fist in Q3
description: Billionaire hedge fund manager Bill Ackman has made significant investments in Brookfield Corporation and Nike, with Brookfield being his largest holding. While Brookfield offers modest dividends, it has delivered impressive returns, unlike Nike which has struggled recently.

title: Here Are Billionaire Bill Ackman's 5 Biggest Stock Holdings
description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman's hedge fund Pershing Square Capital Management has a concentrated portfolio of just 11 stocks. The top five holdings are Brookfield Corporation, Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Chipotle Mexican Grill, Restaurant Brands International, and Howard Hughes Holdings.

title: Why Brookfield Stock Surged Nearly 16% in November
description: Brookfield, a global investment firm, reported strong Q3 results and saw its stock rally 15.8% in November. Billionaire investor Bill Ackman significantly increased his stake in Brookfield, seeing it as an attractive investment opportunity with growth potential in alternative asset management and other sectors.

title: Here Are Billionaire Bill Ackman's 5 Biggest Stock Holdings
description: Billionaire Bill Ackman's Pershing Square hedge fund has a concentrated portfolio of just nine stocks, with most positions ranging from $1.2 billion to $2 billion. Ackman has been active in the market, recently adding to his positions in Brookfield and Nike, and is considering acquiring the remaining stake in Howard Hughes Corporation.

title: Brookfield Corporation Announces Pricing of $700 Million Subordinated Notes Due 2055
description: Brookfield Corporation announced the pricing of a $700 million public offering of subordinated notes due 2055. The notes will bear interest at an annual rate of 6.300% until January 15, 2035 and will be reset every five years thereafter. The net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

title: KBW Announces Index Rebalancing for Fourth-Quarter 2024
description: KBW, a subsidiary of Stifel Financial, announced changes to four of its indexes for Q4 2024, including additions and removals of various financial services and fintech companies.

title: My Favorite Financial Stock to Buy in 2025 for Less Than $200
description: Brookfield, a Canadian financial services company with over $900 billion in assets under management, is a high-potential stock to consider for your portfolio in 2025. The company has consistently delivered annual returns of 15% or more over the past 30 years, outperforming most market indexes and even legendary conglomerates like Berkshire Hathaway. Brookfield's co-investment model, which includes investing its own capital and client funds, has been the key to its success.

title: CRC’s Carbon TerraVault Receives EPA Permits for CO2 Injection and Storage in California
description: California Resources Corporation (CRC) and its carbon management business, Carbon TerraVault (CTV), have received the state's first Class VI permits from the EPA for underground injection and storage of carbon dioxide (CO2) into the 26R reservoir at CRC's Elk Hills Field in California. This milestone underscores CRC's leadership in the carbon capture and storage sector and its capability to deliver carbon management solutions.
